assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE game sprite atlas, 4 columns by 2 rows, transparent PNG, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1024. Eight equally sized square cells, each contains ONE complete isolated medieval fantasy tower, centered at exactly the same scale and ground line, with generous transparent padding between cells. BOTTOM ROW 5) wooden ballista mounted on round stone tower with golden details; 6) frost tower icy pale blue crystal spire on stone base; 7) earthquake tower sturdy stone and bronze totem with amber rune slab; 8) poison tower small alchemist tower with green glass cauldron and emerald magical glow. Art style: polished hand-painted CARTOON mobile tower defense, chunky bevelled shapes, 3/4 orthographic elevated view, consistent frontal camera and upper-left light, highly readable distinct silhouettes, subtle 3D volume on 2D sprites. Soft small contact shadows only. Towers fill about 65 percent cell width and 78 percent cell height; no sprite may touch another cell. Real alpha transparent background, no checkerboard, no scene, no people, no UI, no watermark. One atlas image with exactly EIGHT towers in a REGULAR 4 by 2 layout.
